question: What claim is made about the agency and extent of the yoginī named Wish?
premises: The yoginī named Wish is in view.
She is associated with the siddhas.
By supreme will she extends up to the end of Māyā.
inference: The yoginī named Wish, by supreme will, extends up to the end of Māyā in association with the siddhas.
uncertainties: The precise mode of association with the siddhas is not specified here.
plain_english: The yoginī named Wish, by supreme will, extends up to the end of Māyā through the siddhas.
